newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firms show Jan-Feb PLN 1.6 bln net profit.
newsitem.headline: Polish firms show Jan-Feb PLN 1.6 bln net profit.

text.p: Polish enterprises reported an overall 1.6 billion zloty net profit in the January-February period, compared with a 1.1 billion zloty net profit in the same period of 1996, the Central Statistical Office (GUS) said.
GUS said the private sector had a net profit of 0.9 billion zlotys on total revenues of 48.1 billion in the period against a profit of 0.3 billion and sales of 33.8 in the same period last year.
The state-owned sector reported a profit of 0.7 billion on sales of 47.1 billion versus last year's 0.8 billion and 39.5 billion respectively.
NOTES: Data collected from all companies employing more than 50 people in main sectors of the economy.
Liquidity ratio is a percentage relation of cash reserves and tradable securities to short-term liabilities.
